name: billion-context
description: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions (billions of tokens), small context windows (a 100K context is enough), and token savings (5x fewer tokens).
one_liner: A plugin that compresses an AI coding assistant's memory of a long conversation so it can keep working on the same project for weeks without forgetting earlier context or running up a huge API bill.
buyer: A startup or agency running AI coding agents heavily (e.g. an 'AI dev shop') that's watching its Claude or GPT API token bill climb and wants the same results for a fraction of the cost.
business_use_cases: An AI-coding agency installs it across every client project to cut their Claude API token spend by roughly 5x, improving project margins.
A solo indie hacker running month-long autonomous coding agent sessions uses it to avoid hitting context limits or restarting the agent's memory.
A dev-tools consultant offers a paid 'AI cost audit' service, installing context-compression tools like this one for clients burning through token budgets.

money_ideas.idea: Paid 'cut your AI API bill' audit and setup service for agencies running heavy agent workloads
Managed/hosted version with support for teams who don't want to configure it themselves

steal_this: Install it on your own heaviest AI-agent workflow this week, measure the token savings, and pitch that exact before/after number to one agency client as a paid cost-cutting install.
